target_text: // One fp32 (the 32-bit IEEE single format) in bytes.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The second sentence restates the memcpy calls at lines 51 and 59, and bf16 is a code identifier (tron::bf16) that needs no definition in a comment. The name F32_BYTES_4 carries the rest; only the fp32 definition is a fact the code does not say.

Proposed:
```cpp
// One fp32 (the 32-bit IEEE single format) in bytes.
```
